topic: Someone finds their partner's bucket list
text: Found that piece of paper tucked away in the back of the drawer. A bucket list, neat and tidy, with none of my name scrawled next to any of it. Took a stroll in the rain to think. Funny how the world keeps spinning, doesn’t care if you’ve got a map or not. The streets were slick, my shoes even slicker. Fact is, you can’t plan for every turn, especially when the road splits and you’re the one left standing at the forkalone. Maybe it’s time to look at my own list, see what’s worth chasing before the rain washes it all away.
